title: NDL PubSec MCP
description: Find UK public sector data, check metadata against xGov MEM, explain open standards and look up business terms with their certification state.

env.NDL_MCP_VOCAB_PATH: <optional: a vocabulary file in the R2 register shape>

safety.file_access: only the vocabulary file named in NDL_MCP_VOCAB_PATH
safety.human_in_loop: term certification is reported, never granted: only a register marked endorsed at review level H2 or above counts as certified

tools.name: catalogue_search
tools.title: Search data.gov.uk
tools.description: Search the data.gov.uk catalogue and return titles, publishers, licences, formats and links.

tools.name: dataset_describe
tools.title: Describe a dataset and check it against xGov MEM
tools.description: One dataset plus a draft xGov MEM record and what it still lacks.

tools.name: metadata_validate
tools.title: Validate metadata against xGov MEM
tools.description: Errors and warnings for any metadata record, each with its attribute path.

tools.name: standard_explain
tools.title: Explain an open data standard
tools.description: Purpose, status, licence and link for standards used across government, with provenance.

tools.name: term_lookup
tools.title: Look up a business term and whether it is certified
tools.description: Definition, status, drafted-by, review level and certification for terms in the configured vocabulary.

tools.name: domain_list
tools.title: List the MCP servers in this estate
tools.description: The other MCP servers in the estate, their tools and safety statements.
